factionMagicItems.name: The Tomb Blade of Arkhan
factionMagicItems.rules: If the bearer has joined Zombies, Skeletons, Tomb Guard or Wight infantry, add a new model whenever the bearer kills a man-sized enemy with this blade. New models do not fight in the melee phase in which they are added.

factionMagicItems.name: Sword of Kings
factionMagicItems.rules: Wights only. Each wound becomes 1D6 wounds. No armour save.

factionMagicItems.name: Ring of Night Creatures
factionMagicItems.rules: Vampires only. All Giant Wolves and Giant Bats become Stubborn using the bearer's Leadership.

factionMagicItems.name: Sceptre of Phantoms
factionMagicItems.rules: Bound spell, up to three uses. A visible unengaged enemy within 24 inches must immediately take a Panic test unless immune to Panic or Fear.

factionMagicItems.name: Amulet of Death
factionMagicItems.rules: Contains Hand of Dust as a bound spell; may be cast three times during the game against an opponent in melee combat.

factionMagicItems.name: Wristbands of Black Gold
factionMagicItems.rules: Bearer and mount have a 3+ ward save against all shooting attacks, including ranged magical attacks and Banshee howls.

factionMagicItems.name: Black Skull Talisman
factionMagicItems.rules: Bearer ignores the first wound suffered.

factionMagicItems.name: Cursed Book
factionMagicItems.rules: Undead characters only. Living models suffer -1 to hit the bearer and the bearer's regiment with shooting and melee attacks. Bearer may only join undead regiments containing no living models.

factionMagicItems.name: The Green Pearl
factionMagicItems.rules: Vampires only. +1 Magic Level without learning an additional spell.

factionMagicItems.name: Sword of Unholy Power
factionMagicItems.rules: Also a magic weapon. Each enemy model slain by the bearer generates one personal winds-of-magic card for the bearer in the next magic phase.

factionMagicItems.name: Forbidden Grimoire
factionMagicItems.rules: Lich Lords, Necromancers and Undead Priests only. The caster may attempt the same spell repeatedly in a magic phase until it is successfully cast.

factionMagicItems.name: Staff of Damnation
factionMagicItems.rules: Bound spell. Cast Vanhel's Danse Macabre for free up to three times per game, no more than once per magic phase.

factionMagicItems.name: Wight King's Crown
factionMagicItems.rules: Lich Lords and Necromancers only. Allows Wights to be raised instead of Skeletons with specified raising spells.

factionMagicItems.name: The Necronomicon
factionMagicItems.rules: Lich Lords, Necromancers and Undead Priests may replace a spell with Raise the Dead and raise an extra 1D6 Skeletons or Zombies with specified raising spells.

faction.name: Vampire Counts
armyWideRules: Uses the shared Undead army-wide rules.
All Vampires in the army must belong to the same bloodline.
Each bloodline power is unique within the army and is not cancelled by effects that cancel magic items.
The general need not be a Vampire and the army may contain no Vampires.

von_carstein.name: Wolf Form
von_carstein.rules: Movement Allowance 9. May join Giant Wolves and receive a Look Out, Sir roll.

von_carstein.name: Transfix
von_carstein.rules: Enemies in base contact must pass a Leadership test or will not strike the Vampire; does not affect models immune to psychology.

von_carstein.name: Dark Majesty
von_carstein.rules: +1 combat resolution. If taken by the general, all undead units within 18 inches may march.

von_carstein.name: Summon Wolves
von_carstein.rules: One use only. Summons 1D6+1 Giant Wolves at a randomly determined table edge at the start of a Vampire turn; they may move but not charge.

von_carstein.name: Call Storm
von_carstein.rules: One use only. For one complete turn BS shooting is -2, other shooting only works on 4+, and flying is impossible.

lahmian.name: Mist Form
lahmian.rules: May fly up to 20 inches, except when charging into melee combat.

lahmian.name: Transfix
lahmian.rules: Enemies in base contact must pass a Leadership test or will not strike the Vampire; does not affect models immune to psychology.

lahmian.name: Beguile
lahmian.rules: Living enemies within 8 inches suffer -1 Leadership.

lahmian.name: Death's Pale Beauty
lahmian.rules: Living enemies suffer -1 to hit the Vampire in melee combat.

lahmian.name: Domination
lahmian.rules: Enemies in base contact must pass a Leadership test or cannot strike in melee combat and are hit automatically; no effect on models immune to psychology.

necrarch.name: Dark Acolyte
necrarch.rules: Counts as one extra magic level without gaining the extra spell.

necrarch.name: Dark Summoner
necrarch.rules: May replace a spell with Raise the Dead and raises an extra 1D6 Skeletons or Zombies with specified raising spells.

necrarch.name: Master of the Black Arts
necrarch.rules: May take an extra personal magic card each magic phase.

blood_dragon.name: Terrifying Challenger
blood_dragon.rules: Enemy characters challenged by the Vampire must pass a Leadership test or refuse and hide if possible; no effect on models immune to psychology.

blood_dragon.name: Beast Slayer
blood_dragon.rules: When fighting with mundane weapons, each wound caused multiplies into 1D3 wounds.

blood_dragon.name: Martial Excellence
blood_dragon.rules: +1 to hit on all melee attacks.

strigoi.name: Lord of the Beasts
strigoi.rules: All Giant Wolves and Giant Bats become Stubborn using the Vampire's Leadership.

strigoi.name: Blood Gorger
strigoi.rules: After breaking or wiping out a living enemy, may feed instead of pursuing and recover one lost wound; not while frenzied.

strigoi.name: Killer Instinct
strigoi.rules: Each wound caused multiplies into 1D3 wounds.

strigoi.name: Malignant Envy
strigoi.rules: May re-roll all failed attacks each combat round.

strigoi.name: Summon Ghouls
strigoi.rules: One use only. Summon 1D6+2 Ghouls at a randomly determined table edge; they may move but not charge.

strigoi.name: Hell Beast
strigoi.rules: +1 Wound, can fly, uses a 40x40 base and may join Giant Bats with Look Out, Sir.

characters.name: Swain
rules: A Lahmian Swain is a human hero enthralled by a Vampire mistress.
May be the Battle Standard Bearer for +20 pts only if carrying neither a shield nor a weapon upgrade; faction-specific Swain variants are not yet automated.

regiments.name: Ghouls
rules: If not skirmishing, unbreakable in combat while the undead side outnumbers the enemy
After winning a combat in which the enemy suffered at least one casualty, must gorge and cannot pursue or overrun unless compelled by Hatred or Frenzy

options.rules: Every Wraith rides an ethereal Undead Steed.

regiments.name: Zombies
rules: Slow: always strike last, even when charging
sourceNotes: The source also allows a Vampire Thrall for 60 pts or Wraith Champion for 50 pts; selectable champion type is a future UI enhancement.

regiments.name: Skeleton Warriors
sourceNotes: Longbows/crossbows are only legal when taking no other equipment; source also allows Vampire Thrall or Wraith Champion alternatives.

regiments.name: Skeleton Horsemen
rules: Fast cavalry unless upgraded to heavy armour

options.rules: No longer fast cavalry; standard bearer becomes free.

sourceNotes: Source also allows a mounted Vampire Thrall for 80 pts or mounted Wraith Champion for 70 pts.

regiments.name: Wight Guardsmen
sourceNotes: Source also allows Vampire Thrall 70 pts or Wraith Champion 60 pts.

regiments.name: Wight Knights
sourceNotes: Source also allows mounted Vampire Thrall 80 pts or mounted Wraith Champion 70 pts.

regiments.name: Giant Wolves
rules: Cannot take a standard bearer or musician

regiments.name: Rat Swarms
rules: Available to Necrarch armies as described in the Skaven army book

regiments.name: Vampire Knights
rules: May march even when more than 12 inches from the general

regiments.name: Ghasts
rules: Unbreakable in combat while the undead side outnumbers the enemy
Must gorge after winning a combat in which the enemy suffered a casualty; cannot pursue or overrun unless compelled by Hatred or Frenzy

warMachines.name: Black Coach
rules: Large undead chariot pulled by two Undead Steeds and driven by a Wraith with a Wraith-Weapon
The Wraith is a character; if slain, the Black Coach crumbles immediately
Wraith causes terror and is ethereal
Each wound caused in melee by the Coach, its steeds or Wraith immediately restores one lost wound; if none are lost, the Coach instead gains scythed wheels for the rest of the battle
The Wraith may take one magic item

warMachines.name: Unridden Zombie Dragon
rules: Enemies in base contact suffer -1 to hit in melee
Breath attack wounds on 4+ with no armour save

warMachines.name: Banshee
rules: Ghostly Howl: in the shooting phase, even after marching, target a living non-deaf enemy within 8 inches; it suffers 2D6+2 minus its Leadership wounds with no armour save. Randomise normally if shooting into melee.

specialCharacters.name: Vlad and Isabella von Carstein
rules: Vlad is a Von Carstein Vampire Lord and level 2 wizard; Isabella is a Vampire Thrall.
Vlad carries the Carstein Ring and Dark Majesty; Isabella has Transfix.
Vlad may take one additional magic item and one additional bloodline power.

Carstein Ring: one use; if Vlad is killed he returns within 12 inches with one wound, loses equipment and magic items, but keeps spells and bloodline powers; this prevents army crumble from the general's death.
Vlad and Isabella must stay together and try to reunite if separated. If one is killed permanently, the other gains Frenzy and Hatred.

specialCharacters.name: Mannfred von Carstein
rules: May take four magic items or bloodline powers in any combination.

specialCharacters.name: Konrad von Carstein
rules: May take two magic items or bloodline powers
